title: PrismQuant: Optimal Null-Space Rotations for Grouped Quantizers
abstract: arXiv:2609.32429v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Smaller activation outliers do not necessarily imply better low-bit quantization: their alignment with the quantizer matters. We introduce PrismQuant, a quantizer-aware rotation framework that aligns the leading activation eigenspace with the constant group subspace of asymmetric grouped INT4. The affine offsets represent the energy in this subspace without widening the range within the group. We formulate rotation design as a Ky Fan trace maximization and derive a closed-form solution that is provably optimal for this alignment objective. Compact Householder transformations and their compact-WY representation enable gradient-free construction and efficient application at both foldable and online sites. A predictive range law further connects unaligned activation energy and group size to quantization-relevant variation. translated_title: PrismQuant：面向分组量化器的最优零空间旋转
translated_abstract: 更小的激活异常值并不一定意味着更好的低比特量化：关键在于它们与量化器的对齐程度。我们提出了PrismQuant，这是一个量化器感知的旋转框架，将激活的主特征空间与非对称分组INT4的常数组子空间对齐。仿射偏移在该子空间中表示能量，而不会扩大组内的数值范围。我们将旋转设计表述为Ky Fan迹最大化问题，并推导出一个对该对齐目标可证明最优的闭式解。紧凑的Householder变换及其compact-WY表示使得无需梯度的构建以及在可折叠和在线位置的高效应用成为可能。一个预测性的范围定律进一步将未对齐的激活能量和组大小与量化相关的变化联系起来。在Llama、Qwen和Mistral上的实验涵盖了高达70B参数的稠密模型和30B的混合专家模型。
tldr: PrismQuant提出了一种量化器感知的旋转框架，通过将旋转设计表述为Ky Fan迹最大化并推导出可证明最优的闭式解，将激活主特征空间与非对称分组INT4量化的常数组子空间精确对齐，从而在不扩大组内数值范围的前提下提升低比特量化效果。
en_tdlr: PrismQuant introduces a quantizer-aware rotation framework that aligns the leading activation eigenspace with the constant group subspace of asymmetric grouped INT4 quantization, formulating rotation design as Ky Fan trace maximization with a provably optimal closed-form solution to improve low-bit quantization without widening the in-group range.
